sloka: एष ते राम गंगाया विस्तरो अभिहितो मया ।स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि भद्रम् ते संध्या कालो अतिवर्तते ॥१-४४-२०॥
transliteration: eṣa te rāma gaṁgāyā vistaro abhihito mayā ।svasti prāpnuhi bhadram te saṁdhyā kālo ativartate ॥1-44-20॥

translations.english: O Rama I have related you the story of Ganga in detail. Evening time is passing by (and we shall perform the ablutions) farewell.
